name: [Spellbook 184-4682-4893] Infinite card draw for all players, Infinite draw triggers for all players, Near-infinite colored mana, Near-infinite colorless mana, Near-infinite Treasure tokens

other:
Notable prerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

Spellbook description: Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {1}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
